section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study, consisting of 249 college women from a university in the Midwestern U.S. The mean age was 19.1 years, and 86.3% identified as White/Caucasian. The sample included students from various academic years, with a majority being first-year students.
section_summary.evidence_source: The final data set included responses from 249 college women from a regional campus of a large university in the Midwestern U.S. Participants ranged in age from 18 to 28 (M = 19.1, SD = 1.7). Most identified as White/Caucasian (86.3%). They represented first-year students (77.1%), sophomores (12.9%), juniors (5.6%), seniors (2.4%), and post-baccalaureate or graduate students (2.0%).
